input_packets: MDCLXXXIII Clifford antipodal A5 selector group

reading: The raw A5 selector is exactly one 60-element torsor. The W33 spread selector lives in the 51840-element negative-polar/W(E6) symmetry, so the missing selector index is 864. Independently, the draft golden selector has exactly 864 ordered nonlocal quadrangle failures, and the local signed affine shell has exactly 864 candidates. The obstruction size is therefore not just a selector bug count: it is the exact coset-size required to pass from A5 to the W(E6) negative-polar selector scale.
claim_boundary: This proves equality of three exact 864-element counts and their substrate decomposition. It does not yet construct a canonical bijection from failed ordered quadrangles to O^-(6,2)/A5 cosets or to signed AGL(2,3) candidates. That bijection is the next selector target.
next_target: Build a canonical transport map whose fibers send the 108 unique golden failures, with their 8 orientations, onto the 864 cosets of the raw A5 torsor inside the negative-polar selector symmetry.
